market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $75,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: BTC is at ~$80,900 on May 7. May low so far is $78,178 (May 1). Reaching $75k requires breaking below the May low by ~4%. With 24 days remaining and BTC currently in uptrend, possible but not the central case. Recent momentum (3-day rally to $82k) reduces probability somewhat.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Single sharp risk-off move could easily breach $75k; otherwise unlikely.
